listing.name: Railroad Tycoon (Open Railroad Tycoon)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Open Railroad Tycoon; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream describes railway/economy/AI/save features. Exact simulation parity and complete original-game coverage remain Unknown here. Feature completeness follows docs/FEATURES.md; runtime packages alone do not prove exact original simulation parity. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64, Linux x86-64 AppImage/tar.gz, macOS ARM64/x86-64; OCaml5/opam/SDL2 builds. Original data: Own original RailroadTycoon DOS files *.PIC,*.PAN,*.DTA in data/ or --data-dir. Exact game revision/hash is not specified in reviewed README. No separate BIOS/firmware input is described. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
